description: This file defines the ItemLookup class which extends ItemDetailsLookup. It provides a way to retrieve item details from a RecyclerView, specifically for NoteViewHolder instances, to support item selection logic in an Android app.

classes.name: ItemLookup
classes.description: Provides a method to look up item details in a RecyclerView based on MotionEvent coordinates for selection purposes.

methods.name: ItemLookup
methods.description: Constructor initializing the ItemLookup with a RecyclerView.

methods.name: getItemDetails
methods.description: Retrieves item details corresponding to a MotionEvent, returning details if the touched view is a NoteViewHolder.
